name: vault-mcp-connect
description: Session-start health check and status command for the Vault MCP Obsidian bridge (plugin id 'vault-mcp'; named 'governor' between 0.12.0 and the host/provider split) — warns when the mcp__vault-mcp__* (or legacy mcp__governor__*) tools will fail because Obsidian isn't serving the socket. Also ships the record-class write guard: PreToolUse hook refusing non-append Bash/MCP writes to 'Machinery record/' fold archives.
